Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring an ethical audit of the personnel management systems at community and technical colleges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring an ethical audit of the personnelmanagement systems at community and technical colleges; creating a newsection; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall conduct an ethical audit of the personnel managementsystems of the community and technical colleges. The audit shall becompleted by November 15, 2009. Results of the audit shall be reportedto the legislature by December 1, 2009. In conducting the audit, thejoint legislative audit and review committee shall review the followingissues including but not limited to: (a) Practices for employing parttime rather than fulltimefaculty; (b) Practices for recruiting, hiring, terminating, and promotingparttime faculty; (c) Salary disparities for fulltime and parttime faculty; (d) Benefits for parttime and fulltime faculty; (e) Policies on sick leave and vacation time; p. 1 SB 5089 (f) Access to facilities and support services for parttimefaculty; and (g) Teaching assignments for parttime faculty. (2) This section expires December 31, 2009.
